variations.name: Big Type
variations.rationale: An oversized typographic editorial with an electric yellow palette, a movable punctuation mark, and a tightly composed career ledger.

variations.name: Field of Connections
variations.rationale: A midnight-blue spatial composition connects software, people, and businesses through an interactive orbital diagram, with a quiet, highly readable biography beneath.

variations.name: The Red Index
variations.rationale: A Swiss-inspired split-screen index pairs a monumental red nameplate with numbered, expandable chapters. Native disclosures keep the experience tactile and usable without JavaScript.

variations.name: A Working Landscape
variations.rationale: A warm, literary landscape of olive ink, paper tones, and hand-drawn contours. A broad illustrated opening leads into an asymmetric reading layout and an optional dark reading mode.

variations.name: Open Studio
variations.rationale: A playful gallery of oversized lavender, peach, and cobalt panels uses modular geometry and a visitor-controlled sculpture to make a compact personal site feel like an exhibition.
